name: React Email
summary: Unstyled React and TypeScript components for building HTML emails, plus 60+ copy-paste patterns and open-source templates.
description: Open-source library for writing emails as React components instead of HTML tables: unstyled primitives (Html, Head, Body, Button, Container, Section, Row, Column, Text, Img, Link, Preview …) plus a pattern library of 60+ copy-paste components across 25 categories and open-source email templates, some with Figma files. Components are tested on the popular email clients, output converts to HTML or plain text for any provider, and an embeddable editor, CLI and docs for LLMs ship with it.
contains: 60+ copy-paste components across 25 categories (headers, footers, buttons, avatars, gallery, list, code)
unstyled primitives: Html, Head, Body, Button, Container, Section, Row, Column, Text, Img, Link, Hr, Preview, Font
email templates: 5 official themes (Barebone, Matte, Protocol, Arcane, Studio) plus community templates
components tested on Gmail, Apple Mail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, HEY and Superhuman
integrations: Resend, SendGrid, Mailgun, AWS SES, Postmark, Nodemailer, Azure, MailerSend, Brevo and more
embeddable email editor for your own product
25 docs pages; llms.txt, llms-full.txt and markdown versions for AI agents; React Email skill
